analyst_view.overall: Levante (18th, 11 pts) host Racing Santander (7th, 17 pts) on Friday night in a game the numbers make a clear home win with 3.8 goals. Luis Castro's Levante play Elche at home on Monday night, a six-pointer at the bottom, so they get only four days' rest before Friday, which the numbers don't count; their infirmary is nearly empty (Manu Sanchez, Mathew Ryan and Ivan Romero are back), but FutbolFantasy notes their attack has lacked danger, with two defeats and a 0-0 at Celta before Monday. Jose Alberto's Racing beat Real Sociedad 3-2 on Sunday but conceded 31 shots and 14 corners, and they were without Andres Martin (thigh injury) and, briefly, Maguette at the weekend, absences the site's numbers do not list. No referee is named yet; the numbers already count Racing's busy recent shooting both ways (+17.2% shots).

goals.text: The numbers say 3.8 goals, 2.5 of them for Levante. I lean a little lower to about 3.6: Levante's attack has been blunt lately and they play again only four days after Monday's Elche game, a short turnaround the numbers don't count, while Racing had Andres Martin injured at the weekend. Racing's leaky defence (31 shots allowed to Real Sociedad) keeps the lean small.

corners.text: The numbers say 11.4 corners, 7.0 for Levante. Racing give away a lot of corners (14 against Real Sociedad, 40 in six games), which the numbers already count, and Levante under Castro play wide with Brugue and Thiago Fernandez. Nothing new points either way, so I stay at about 11.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.6 cards. Levante are in a relegation fight and have been booked a little less than usual lately, which the numbers already count (-4.7%); no referee is named yet. Monday's result against Elche could raise the tension, but that is not known yet, so I stay at 4.6.

shots.text: The numbers say 35.0 shots, already lifted for Racing's busy recent games at both ends (+17.2% for their shooting, +5.9% for Levante against their defence). Levante's short rest could slow them, but Racing let opponents shoot freely (31 for Real Sociedad), so I stay at 35.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 11.0 shots on target. Racing have been hitting the target often lately (37 in six games, already counted) even without Andres Martin, and Levante have struggled to test goalkeepers. I took the blunter Levante attack off goals already, so I stay at 11.
